scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const d of ['dist','dist-test']) fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.test: npm run build && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist-test',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test dist-test/test/*.test.js
